name: boxIndex
meaning: index of the appear box (loop variable in state 2)

name: appearDelay
meaning: counts not-drawn updates with Ralph in a box while hidden; shown at >= 3; zeroed by SetState(0) and Init

name: targetVert
meaning: random flutter height, Rand_Range(appearPos.y-200, appearPos.y); re-picked within 20 units

name: reverseNext
meaning: as Bird: mirror the orbit on the next SetState(0)

name: wasOnScreen
meaning: inst.flags & INST_F_DRAWN copied in Render, zeroed in Update

name: variant
meaning: _4BUTTERFLY property (0/1/2): 0 -> model APAPIL02, anims 0 (flutter) / 1 (leave); 1 -> APAPIL03, anims 0 / 2; 2 -> APAPIL03, anims 1 / 3

name: orbitRadius
meaning: pos - orbitCentre at the start of a quarter circle

name: appearBoxes
meaning: zone list {boxes, count}: APPEARBOX id-list | count (+4): count from Scn_FindIdList

name: mainModel
meaning: main model snapshot from ScnObject_InitWithAltModels in Butterfly_Create

name: altModels
meaning: id lists {0xb8 WAR_IDO_APAPIL02, 0xb9 WAR_IDO_APAPIL03}; [0] used when variant == 0, [1] otherwise
